object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: With a release installed, record the SHA-256 of each file in the install folder. Start mellon.exe and run the Windows installer. Then quit mellon.exe, have an MCP client start mellon-mcp.exe and make an export call, and run the installer again while the call runs. Expected: each time the installer stops before changing anything, saying Mellon is running; afterwards each file in the install folder has its recorded checksum, and no file was added or removed.
